title: fusion.catalog/v1
description: The role catalog, catalog/catalog.json, copied unchanged into the Prior bundle as catalog.json. One entry per canonical role; every Prior role id (Prior modules/fusion/profiles.json at 167c605) and every Claude agent name (agents/*.md) appears exactly once across the entries, through claude_name, prior_ids or an alias. Both keys are exactly the two Prior reads (internal/fusionhost/external_catalog.go at 8bab88a decodes with DisallowUnknownFields and an exact key count), so no further key is admitted here either. Support states: only prior supported is executable on Prior; planned ships for inspection and refuses dispatch, aliases included; unsupported refuses dispatch and needs no profile (Prior answer 67.2). Rules JSON Schema cannot check and the catalog tests (plan step 5) enforce: canonical ids are unique across entries (jq -r '.roles[].id' | sort | uniq -d prints nothing); claude_name values are unique; every prior_ids entry that differs from the canonical id is listed in aliases with its domain; no alias id equals a canonical id or another alias; every role whose prior state is not unsupported has catalog/profiles/<id>/profile.json, and the bundle carries profiles/<id>.json and profiles/<id>.md for it.

claude_name.description: The Claude Code agent name, agents/<claude_name>.md; null for a role with no Claude agent.

prior_ids.description: Every Prior role id this entry covers; empty for a role Prior has never named. An id other than the canonical one is an alias and must appear in aliases.

aliases.description: New-binding aliases of the canonical role, each carrying the domain the binding preserves (Prior answer 67.3: code-reviewer and data-reviewer alias reviewer with domains code and ontology).

support.description: One state per host, never an absent key.
